Parent epic: bd-01M57PRFCXCDXPB434WTVM24ZJ
Source plan: dev/reviews/2026-10-18/remediation-plan.md (Additional audit qualifications)
Plan SHA256: 0224854b40537bb5866a73a563e72428473e1ded2cfbd1f0a98b4ffc0b20979b

Classification: audit qualification follow-up, separate from the thirteen confirmed defects. Preserve the parent scientific-scope limits.

Action and paths
`dev/run_design_mfa_benchmarks.R`, both iPCA scripts. Preserve raw failed/nonconverged rows; summarize attempted/failed/converged/unknown counts. Compute qualified timing/accuracy comparisons on explicitly eligible draws and report exclusions. Label `r2_y` as training adjusted R-squared; implement held-out fitting only if a predictive claim is retained. Record source hash/dirty state, package/dependency versions, and seed; avoid silently using an unrelated installed muscal.

Acceptance evidence / regression tests
Synthetic five-row benchmark table containing successes, failures, nonconvergence, and unknown convergence yields exact counts and eligible medians. Paired comparisons use the same jointly eligible replicate IDs and retain exclusion reasons. If held-out R2 is added, a fold-isolation fixture proves fitting/preprocessing never sees assessment rows. Extract only the small aggregation helper needed to test this; do not run expensive benchmarks as unit tests.

Completion: record the tested source revision, precise regression names, retained receipts, and unresolved scientific assumptions. A smoke test does not establish calibration.
set.title: Q01: Benchmark qualification
